entries.title: Confirmed Jets front absences prompt a Patriots DST revision
entries.question: Does the now-confirmed Jets defensive loss justify using the remaining $800 despite New England's unfavorable schematic countercase?
entries.why_it_matters: DST was the weakest unresolved availability assumption. A replacement can use existing funds without weakening the eight offensive selections, but a higher salary does not establish better scoring.
findings: Official pool remains 562 rows and eleven games, with unchanged IDs/salaries/positions/game info versus October30.
Jets Ossai and Sweat OUT, Bailey doubtful; opposing Bowers full with no designation. Powers-Johnson questionable after limited Friday work; not an established absence.

Patriots DaQuan Jones and Dre'Mont Jones full with no designation. Miami Proctor OUT; Willis full without designation. Davis/Elliss remain questionable despite full practice, and New England offensive Brown/Henderson are questionable.

October29 Patriots team analysis attributes weak zone efficiency and reliance on blitzing to New England; describes Miami's recent offensive improvement and Willis being more effective against man/blitz than zone/four-man rush. This directly challenges the replacement.
Ravens Lamar, Hamilton and Roquan full Friday without designations; Buffalo Spencer Brown, DJ Moore and Kincaid questionable. Availability improves without proving a high-scoring game.
St. Brown/Gibbs full without designations; Williams not listed. No speculative target redistribution.
Tampa Bay Egbuka OUT with foot injury; Irving full after rest. Gainwell questionable despite full Friday and Goedeke questionable after limited work. No automatic Irving workload boost.
Browns Jenkins full without designation; Howard concussion questionable after three DNPs. Pittsburgh Watt/Highsmith full without designation; protection risk retained.
Chase Brown not listed on current dated Bengals report. Team preview attributes 21 sacks to Bengals but only 11 allowed by Titans, including one over last two games; no easy-sack inference.

Week7 NFL finals and rechecked Jets–Miami box support no material change to inspected archived inputs. No settled platform score or material correction established; Week6 freeze145.98 and Week7 freeze114.22 remain provisional, not newly certified final.
Projection page still covers 13 Sunday–Monday games rather than chosen eleven. All new estimates remain null.
Fresh PR comments contain no new Week8 Claude or Grok contribution. Week7 Grok participation remains preserved and is not mistaken for a Week8 pass.
entries.interpretation: Prefer Patriots DST as a qualitative response to confirmed Jets absences and Miami's missing tackle. Keep eight offensive choices; do not assume Egbuka's absence or healthy returns mechanically redistribute targets. The Patriots' zone/pressure weaknesses and Miami's recent improvement are a serious reason this revision could fail.
alternatives: Jets DST: replace; full lineup $49200, remainder $800. Confirmed front absences crossed prior availability concern into a concrete adverse condition; hold remains plausible because Patriots matchup has its own weaknesses.

Bengals DST: not legal standalone; full lineup $50200, remainder $-200. Requires another $200 funding move. Attributed 21-sack defense is countered by Titans' recent sack avoidance. No supported funding downgrade identified.

Steelers DST: decline today; full lineup $49700, remainder $300. Watt/Highsmith full and Cleveland protection risk support investigation, but this directly opposes retained Concepcion. No coherent projection comparison establishes that package is better.
uncertainty: Patriots coverage/run defense versus Willis and Miami's improved attack; Proctor's absence alone does not imply pressure.
New England Davis/Elliss and offensive Brown/Henderson questionable; Jets Hall and Raiders Powers-Johnson questionable.
Cooper/Taylor role competition; Brown/Perine split; Cleveland pass volume/protection.
Bucs Gainwell/Goedeke final availability and offense without Egbuka.
No coherent complete projection snapshot for the selected eleven-game pool.
No Claude Week8 substantive output, Grok questions or joint revision observed.
entries.lineup_effect: Codex Saturday candidate: Patriots DST replaces Jets; eight held, $50,000/$0 left. Jets exposure falls from three selections to Cooper/Taylor only. Not frozen or shared; Claude Week8 output and Grok Week8 questions remain absent.
change_triggers: Official material availability or role change before freeze.
A supported whole-lineup alternative with legal salaries and stronger role/matchup evidence; no requirement to spend full cap.
Actual version-bound Grok questions or Claude proposal before cutoff. Later replies cannot alter an already valid freeze.
carry_forward: Before freeze recheck material availability, including Patriots Davis/Elliss and offensive Brown/Henderson, Tampa Bay Gainwell/Goedeke, Buffalo supporting injuries and Jets Hall.

Evaluate the DST change as Patriots points minus Jets points under the same exact scoring rules, then assess pressure/coverage conditions separately; a favorable score alone would not validate the mechanism.
Test Miami's protection and Willis mobility against the stated concern using sacks, rushing and accessible pressure/dropback measures. Missing pressure data stays unassessable.
Carry the Cooper/Taylor target-competition question into freeze and postgame role review; removing JetsDST does not resolve their offensive overlap.
Existing Grok request remains pending on its exact Friday inputs. Today's candidate is a separate delta; retain actual question versions and Claude/Codex responses instead of restarting originals.
Keep forecasts null until the exact eleven-game model coverage is verified; earlier scores remain provisional.

expectations.subject: Patriots DST supporting availability
expectations.statement: DaQuan Jones and Dre'Mont Jones are expected to be available participants while Miami tackle Kadyn Proctor is unavailable; this supports the replacement's healthier-front premise, without predicting sacks or fantasy points.
expectations.support: Both Patriots listed full Friday with no game designation; Proctor OUT after three DNPs. Jets alternative has Ossai/Sweat OUT and Bailey doubtful.
expectations.uncertainty: Late availability or role changes; Davis/Elliss still questionable. Proctor's replacement may protect effectively, and Willis mobility/New England coverage can defeat the pressure premise.
expectations.challenge: An unexpected Patriots front absence or minimal participation would challenge the availability premise; sound Miami protection would challenge its assumed practical value.
expectations.observe: Official inactives and defensive participation/snaps; Miami protection lineup and team sacks allowed. Pressure rates only if accessible and attributable; otherwise unassessable. Separate this condition assessment from actual DK points.
